name: Heurilens UX Analyzer
author: heurilens

sections.description:
Heurilens UX Analyzer helps you identify usability issues in your WordPress pages using AI-powered heuristic analysis. Get your UX Score and actionable recommendations to improve user experience.

How It Works

  1. Select any page or post from your WordPress admin
  2. Click “Analyze” to run a UX evaluation
  3. Review your score and detailed findings across 14 heuristics
  4. Fix issues based on prioritized recommendations

14 UX Heuristics Analyzed

Foundation
* Heading Hierarchy
* Contrast & Readability
* Spacing Balance
* Link Clarity

Action
* CTA Presence
* CTA Dominance
* Form UX

Trust
* Social Proof
* Trust Signals

Experience
* Visual/Text Balance
* Cognitive Load
* Alt Text Coverage
* Mobile Hints
* Perceived Performance

External Service

This plugin connects to the Heurilens external service to perform AI-powered UX analysis. When you click “Analyze”, your page content is sent securely to heurilens.com for processing. The analysis is performed on Heurilens servers using AI and the results are returned to your WordPress admin.

This connection is required because the AI analysis cannot be performed locally within the plugin.

  • Service URL: https://heurilens.com/api/wp-plugin
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

A license key can be activated to connect your Heurilens account for enhanced service features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the heurilens folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Heurilens > License to activate your license key (optional)
  4. Navigate to Heurilens > Pages to start analyzing
sections.faq:
Do I need a license key to use this plugin?

No. You can use the plugin without a license key. A license key connects your Heurilens account for enhanced service features.

How does the AI analysis work?

Heurilens uses AI to evaluate your page content against 14 established UX heuristics. The AI identifies issues, explains their impact, and provides specific fixes. The analysis is performed on Heurilens servers as it requires AI processing that cannot be done locally.

Is my page content stored on your servers?

No. Page content is processed in real-time for analysis and is not stored permanently. We only retain aggregated usage statistics.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin only runs in the WordPress admin area when you click “Analyze”. It does not affect your public website performance.
